Dutiyasamudayasutta Origin (2nd)

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Sutavā, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako rūpassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti. “Mendicants, a learned noble disciple truly understands the origin, the disappearance, the gratification, the drawback, and the escape when it comes to form, Vedanāya … feeling, saññāya … perception, saṅkhārānaṁ … choices, viññāṇassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānātī”ti. and consciousness.”

Tatiyaṁ.
